jobs.description: Elanco Animal Health is one of the world's leading animal health companies. in audits, providing appropriate technical expertise and support during audit preparation, execution, and follow-up.What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):- Completed Master's degree in natural sciences, engineering, pharmaceutical technology, or a comparable field.- At least 10 years of professional experience in the pharmaceutical environment, preferably in manufacturing of solid forms.- Experience in creating precise reports, presentations, and documentation from complex scientific concepts for various audiences.- Proven organization and time management skills.- Very good command of written and spoken German and English.What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):- PhD in natural sciences, engineering, or pharmaceutical technology.- JMP® statistical analysis of data experience.- Demonstrated ability for innovative problem-solving and good decision-making.- Experience utilizing statistical modeling/Design of Experiments (DOEs) and risk-based approaches (e.g., FMEA).- Result-oriented, efficient, and accountable way of working with the ability to respond to changing priorities.What We Offer- Competitive Compensation: An attractive salary package and participation in the company's success through our bonus scheme.- Autonomy & Growth: Room for personal initiative and independent action within a modern, growing global pharmaceutical company.- Career Development: Access to our internal global career network with exciting development and training opportunities.- Dynamic Environment: Work in a diverse and interesting environment where your contribution directly impacts animal health worldwide.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

Your experience and skills help you on a daily basis to make additional or changed connections.Your tasks are, amongst others:· Visually checking the PCB with the help of digital instructions and technical drawings· Determining the process, together with manufacturing engineers, for (process) parameters for the series· Identifying deviations from the predetermined standards· Soldering, touch-op and outcoming goods inspectionYou will work with different kind of toolings, such as: soldering iron, hot plates and/or dryers. It is a very precise job where you will be working via a microscope or dynascope.What Benchmark has to offer to you:· A salary between € 2,751 - € 3,292 gross per month based on 40 hour workweek, depending on your knowledge and experience.· Broad development opportunities with the help of our Benchmark Academy.· Entrepreneurship is seen, valued and encouraged.· BeFit program: stay fit by exercising weekly with your colleagues or participating in sporting events.· A turnover-related quarterly bonus that can amount to 5%.
